summary: The patch addresses the issue by ensuring that database converters are called for returning fields on insert operations, but there are some minor concerns regarding readability and potential edge cases.

issues.description: The patch assumes that `returning_fields` and `results` will always have the same length and that each `result` will have the same number of elements as `returning_fields`. While the current implementation seems to work, it might be worth adding checks or comments to clarify these assumptions.
The added loop could be made more readable by using a more descriptive variable name than `result` and by unpacking the `zip` directly in the loop.
